description: This file defines an abstract class WizardAbstract used as a base for conditional formatting wizard logic within PhpSpreadsheet library, handling cell references, styles, and formula adjustments.

classes.name: WizardAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for building conditional formatting rules, such as managing cell ranges, styles, and formula references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wizard with a specified cell range and sets reference cells accordingly.

methods.name: getCellRange
methods.description: Returns the current cell range associated with the wizard.

methods.name: setCellRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range for the wizard and updates reference cells for expressions.

methods.name: setReferenceCellForExpressions
methods.description: Derives the reference cell, column, and row from the cell range for expression calculations.

methods.name: getStopIfTrue
methods.description: Indicates whether subsequent rules should stop if this rule evaluates to true.

methods.name: setStopIfTrue
methods.description: Sets the flag to halt further rule evaluation upon true condition.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style object, creating a default style if none is set.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Assigns a style object to the wizard.

methods.name: validateOperand
methods.description: Validates and formats operand strings based on their type (literal or formula).

methods.name: reverseCellAdjustment
methods.description: Reverses relative cell adjustments to absolute references based on reference cell info.

methods.name: reverseAdjustCellRef
methods.description: Adjusts cell references within a formula string back to original relative positions.

methods.name: conditionCellAdjustment
methods.description: Adjusts cell references within a conditional expression.

methods.name: cellConditionCheck
methods.description: Processes cell references within a condition string for proper cell address adjustment.

methods.name: adjustConditionsForCellReferences
methods.description: Applies cell reference adjustments to multiple conditions.
